label: CITED from published documents (TRA audited statements FY2023/24; NBS Tax Statistics 2023/24; Finance Act 2022; Afrobarometer R9/R10); not estimated

tra_active_business_tins_fy2023_24.source: TRA audited financial statements for the year ended 30 June 2024 (Controller and Auditor General report), printed pp. 107-108
tra_active_business_tins_fy2023_24.does_not_show: business TINs only: no individual / non-individual split, no TINs issued by year, no filers or nil returns

tra_active_business_tins_fy2022_23.source: same statements, prior-year column, printed pp. 107-108

tra_dormant_business_tins_fy2022_23.source: same statements, prior-year column, printed pp. 107-108

tra_tin_stock_mainland_fy2023_24.source: NBS Tax Statistics Report 2023/24, Mainland Tanzania, Table 3.1 (source TRA), printed p. 14 (also data/processed/tra_registered_taxpayers.csv)
tra_tin_stock_mainland_fy2023_24.does_not_show: entities and dormant TINs are included: it is NOT a count of adult taxpayers and not comparable with FinScope's 1.31 million adult TIN holders; the audited statements' registered-business growth (+6%) and VAT-trader change (-20%) conflict with NBS Table 3.1 (VAT +18%) and are unreconciled

nin_to_tin_provision.value: from 1 January 2023 TRA must issue a TIN to every citizen who has a National Identification Number (NIN)
nin_to_tin_provision.source: Finance Act 2022 s. 106, amending the Tax Administration Act s. 22(2)
nin_to_tin_provision.does_not_show: no count of NIN-linked TINs exists in the published statistics

afrobarometer_r9_r10_tax_module.value: absent: the Round 8 tax module (the source of the report's tax-morale items) is not in Round 9, and only 3 of the 6 report items exist in Round 10 (Tanzania 2024, n = 2,400), none with identical wording
afrobarometer_r9_r10_tax_module.source: Afrobarometer Data, Tanzania, Round 9 and Round 10 questionnaires, codebooks and .sav labels (PASS6A D6.1)
afrobarometer_r9_r10_tax_module.does_not_show: no change since 2021 can be stated; R8 values stay labelled 2021

derived.note: COMPUTED from the cited counts: arithmetic only

reading: TRA's own active business TINs (1.85 million) and the TIN stock (6.27 million, entities and dormant TINs included) are not counts of adult taxpayers; FinScope's 1.31 million adult TIN holders is a survey estimate of persons
